children: Bufab invites investors, analysts and media to a Capital Markets Day on December 10, 2026 in Stockholm.

At the Capital Markets Day, Erik Lundén, President and CEO and other members of the Group Executive Management Team, will present an update on Bufab's strategy, opportunities and financial ambitions going forward.
Bufab will also take the opportunity to showcase some of our specialised logistic solutions and products.
The event will take place at Miss Clara by Nobis, Sveavägen 48 in Stockholm, starting at 09.30 CET and concluding with lunch at 12.00.
After lunch, from 13.00 CET, there will be an opportunity to schedule short 1-2-1 meetings with members of the Group Executive Management Team.
These meetings need to be pre-booked.
More information and a detailed agenda will be sent out to registered participants closer to date.
Please register your participation, allergies and if you wish to schedule 1-2-1 meeting by sending an email to Sofie Unnersjö latest October 30:

Bufab is a trading company that offers its customers a full-service solution as Supply Chain Partner for sourcing, quality control, sustainability and logistics for C-Parts. Bufab was founded in 1977 in Småland, Sweden, and is an international group that today consists of more than 60 companies. The group has 1,900 employees in 31 countries and annual sales of SEK 8.1 billion in 2025. The share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm since 2014. Read more on www.bufabgroup.com.
